title: The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe
description: The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe is an expanded reimagining of the critically acclaimed narrative adventure. Step into the office of Stanley, an ordinary employee whose coworkers have mysteriously disappeared. Explore a strange and unpredictable world, make choices that challenge the narrator, and discover countless endings. With new areas, secrets, surprises, and plenty of unexpected twists, every decision leads somewhere different.
